items.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe. Utica, New York, November 6, 2010 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Jay Leonhart subs for me. ... And it was a star cast of bass players. I was petrified. It was Jay [Leonhart], Michael Moore, I think Phil Flanigan, Milt wasn’t there, this was a set for Milt.

ctx.x: Is it your job to send in a sub?
Absolutely. Jay Leonhart subs for me.
Oh. How funny is that. That’s funny.
